protocol.purpose: Gset at 100M accepted flips with a cooling schedule stretched to the longer run, to compare with the published NeuroSA worst-case results.
protocol.selection_rule: One global cooling period for every graph, chosen on a pilot with seed 101 (not an evaluation seed) on G1, G11, G15, G43, G22, G35 among 2^20..2^23 by smallest total gap to the best-known cut. All evaluation runs are kept.
protocol.pilot_note: G15 at 2^20 has no result: a first-hit epoch race in the new counter-unwrapping code aborted that run; fixed before the other periods ran.
protocol.comparison: NeuroSA columns of Supplementary Tables S1/S2 (Chen et al., Nat. Commun. 2025) give the worst case over their runs relative to the best-known (SOTA) cut.
